cards.title: Hidden Power
cards.instruction: Act publicly modest while making choices as though you control the outcome.

cards.title: Don’t Go
cards.instruction: Create reasons another player must stay with you. Never directly ask them to stay.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm only fussing over the soup. Taste it before you catch your train; I'll serve when you've checked it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll add a pinch and give it five minutes. You can do the final taste; I wouldn't trust my own tongue after cooking it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: My train leaves in ten minutes.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll bring the bread out in nine. Just tear off the end and check the middle for me before I cut the rest.
